Memory._note: Empty = %LOCALAPPDATA%/SoulCore/memory/soulcore_memory.db. Never point at LLMOD Data/.

Inference._note: MaxTokens=num_predict (reply length). NumCtx=context window (gemma4 max ~131072; not 256K). Enabled=false → NullInferenceClient. EmbeddingsEnabled=false → RecallRecentAsync-only. MaxToolIterations caps /api/chat agent-loop round-trips (BED-126); default 8.

Hermes._note: BED-144: Enabled=true when the OPS-143 gateway is smoke-ready. Chat + MCP invoke require SOULCORE_HERMES_API_KEY (env/user-secrets) — never put ApiKey values in this file. PreferHermes=false still uses Ollama for chat; desktop/browser/mt4 tools with Backend=hermes call IHermesMcpInvoker regardless. Keep Host appsettings.json Hermes.Enabled=false until QA-145 e2e Pass. Model is Hermes-side (gemma4:64k / num_ctx 65536) — do not point Hermes at qwen2.5:14b GGUF (32768 cap).

ChatWs._note: Presence clients: ws://127.0.0.1:7700/ws. StubWhenModelDown=false → error frame chat.model_down when LLM unreachable (no silent stub success). PreferHermes=true → Ollama Host tool-loop + Hermes MCP-only via CallMcpToolAsync (never Hermes CompleteWithToolsAsync/tools[] on hermes-agent 0.18.2); gateway/key down fails fast before the Ollama loop. Companion token is NOT configured here — use env SOULCORE_COMPANION_API_TOKEN (≥32 random chars). When set, /ws requires Authorization: Bearer or X-Api-Key; when unset, local loopback desktop keeps no-header trust.

UnrealBridge._note: Body host is Shadow PC over Tailscale (MagicDNS house-victoria). Local PIE override: UnrealBridge__WsUrl=ws://127.0.0.1:8888. Host must not crash if UE down.

Voice._note: Local faster-whisper (:8000) + Chatterbox (:8881) via House/House.Voice start scripts. PlayOnHostSpeakers = PC speakers; PlayInUnreal = UE downloads /api/voice/last.wav.

SoulLoop._note: KILL SWITCH: Enabled=false by default. Scaffold want + optional proactive chat.done to companions. No browser/MT4/email/file acts. ProactiveChatIntervalTicks=0 disables outbound chat pushes.

Companion._note: Victoria Link HTTP surface under /api/companion/v1. Same Bearer/X-Api-Key gate as /ws when SOULCORE_COMPANION_API_TOKEN is set. MediaStorePath empty → %LOCALAPPDATA%/SoulCore/companion-media. DefaultContactId is a stub for a future external persona service.

Safety._note: Phase 3 safety knobs. Rates default $0 (set per provider). MonthlyTokenCap=0 disables token ceiling. When CapExceeded, chat inference is refused (chat.spend_cap).

Tools._note: BED-133 filesystem + BED-169 MT4 via LLMOD MCP HTTP on shadow (house-victoria:8080). DesktopBackend=cua → cua-driver agent cursor (same blue overlay as LLMOD). SoftCursorRestore=true → background clicks (OS mouse untouched). Mt4Backend=hermes remains optional Hermes fallback via IHermesMcpInvoker. AllowComputerControl defaults true (TASK-177; session-toggleable; was opt-in). AllowMt4Read/Trade default false; execute_trade still requires confirmed=true + sl.

_secrets_note: Do not put API tokens here. Use env SOULCORE_* or `dotnet user-secrets`. Key names: SOULCORE_A2E_TOKEN, SOULCORE_HERMES_API_KEY, SOULCORE_HF_TOKEN, SOULCORE_COMPANION_API_TOKEN.
